summary: Iteration 10 — validated the 3 new features end-to-end: (1) Persona landing pages /for/schools|hospitals|offices render hero, 4 benefit cards, 3-step how-it-works, and register+contact CTAs; invalid /for/xyz redirects to /; landing personas 0-2 have Learn more links to correct routes. (2) Admin bulk TAG batch generation: /admin/qr gen form 'ID Tag' reveals Organization field; generating a 3-tag batch works, appears in batches, exposes CSV+Print. (3) Tag claim/activation: /claim/{serial} correctly branches to tag form for intended_type=tag, shows org name, reveals guardian/medical fields for person types (kid/patient/staff/person) and hides them for bag, submits and shows claim-done + go-tag. Backend pytest (7/7 PASS) covers bulk gen with product_type+org_name, /public/claim preview returns intended_type+org_name, /qr/claim tag branch persists guardian, /public/tag hides guardian_phone (never leaked), and kid_help emergency alert returns 200. Regression: public vehicle /scan/{demo_QR} still renders plate/vehicle. Twilio/WhatsApp mocked as expected — never asserted on real delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonaLanding.jsx: uses Navigate to='/' on invalid persona — verified redirect works.
Claim.jsx: cleanly branches on preview.intended_type === 'tag'; guardian fields gated on TAG_PERSON list (kid/patient/staff/person) — verified toggling to 'bag' hides them.
AdminQR.jsx: org_name field is conditionally rendered only when product_type === 'tag' — good UX; sent as null otherwise.
Backend server.py: /public/tag payload never includes guardian_phone, and public masked-call response omits number too (verified in pytest — '9000012345' never appears in response body).

Emergency broadcast: server.py line ~1791 `emergency = payload.type in ('kid_help','sos','emergency')` bypasses prefs and notifies both owner+guardian with maps link — verified via alert POST returning 200 for kid_help.
Minor (carry-over from iter9): server.py is ~4k lines, would benefit from splitting into routers.
seed_data_creation: 1 admin tag batch (TEST_UITAG_*, 3 tags NS-2608-000154..156, org 'TEST_UI_School'), 1 activated TEST_UI_Kid tag — the kid tag was cleaned up via delete-tag UI. The 2 remaining NS-2608-000155/156 unclaimed serials are harmless (blocked/deletion of unclaimed inventory isn't exposed in UI). context_for_next_testing_agent: New selectors verified working: persona-landing-{schools|hospitals|offices}, persona-benefit-0..3, persona-cta-register, persona-cta-contact, persona-cta-register-bottom, persona-cta-contact-bottom, persona-link-0..2 (on landing), gen-product-type (select), gen-org-name (revealed when product_type=tag), claim-tag-name, claim-tag-type, claim-tag-blood, claim-tag-medical, claim-tag-guardian-name, claim-tag-guardian-phone, claim-submit, claim-done, go-tag. Login: /login shows email/password form by default; if OTP form is shown, click text 'Password login' to switch. Sign-in button is a <button> with text 'Sign in'. Admin login redirects to /dashboard first — navigate directly to /admin/qr afterwards. A fresh serial can only be claimed once — generate a new batch for repeat tests. Demo NS-2608-000155/156 remain unclaimed in inventory after this run and are safe to reuse.
